company_evidence.bounded_problem: As coding agents act directly in repositories, agent-generated changes require security validation, policy-constrained workflow execution, human approval at sensitive boundaries, and trustworthy promotion into canonical repository state.

blockers.meaning: The current proof exercises the provider-independent control kernel with in-memory adapters; a real bounded GitHub mutation path has not been executed by this implementation.
GitHub-hosted proof jobs were blocked before execution by the account Actions budget; exact-source local reproduction is the current executable proof.

evolution.cursor: Implement a GitHub provider adapter using bounded short-lived repository authority; exercise expected-head mutation, provider confirmation, canonical readback, replay prevention, and receipt persistence against a disposable or otherwise reversible target; then reproduce the proof on canonical source before any further promotion.

nonclaims: No production GitHub mutation or deployment is established by the current proof.
No production reliability, scale, latency, or throughput is claimed.
No GitHub affiliation, endorsement, employment, or adoption is implied.
The proof state applies to the Merge Authority Graph capability, not the repository's older Notion/Neon/memory surfaces.
